answer: Unimpressed: re-execution sampling only works when the sample comes from peers who cannot coordinate, so draw 1 in 12 from a different subnet and client build each time. A canyon of identical hosts re-runs its own traces and finds nothing, while a wide orchard with one owner hides less than it hopes: up close every lotus shows a single root. A failed audit slashes the bond 30 percent and publishes the batch. Cost: 83 re-runs per 1,000 identities, each one a chance to be caught.
